# rauthy_group (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Rauthy group by name, for referring to groups this configuration does not manage.

Requires the `Groups:read` API key right.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rauthy_group" "developers" {
  name = "developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rauthy-assigned identifier of the group.
